column3: “Salvation is established” makes passive the clause in which he sets salvation as walls and rampart.
The Hebrew addresses the “upright One”; the translation instead makes “upright” describe the person whose path is cleared.
“We walk” supplies a verb for the phrase about the path of judgments.
“Your” and “set” make explicit the relationship in the phrases about zeal for a people and fire for adversaries.
The phrase “through You” is not explicitly retained.
“A quiet prayer” specifies the whispered utterance.
“Nor brought any life into the world” renders the clause about the inhabitants of the world not falling.
“Their bodies” replaces “my corpse”; “morning” renders “lights,” and “her dead” renders the shades brought forth by the earth.
